//AutoRefreshSeconds: How often a page reloads itself. 0 disables it; the minimum otherwise is
10. It is a meta refresh rather than script, because the CSP on these
pages is default-src 'none' and keeping them script-free is deliberate.
The whole document reloads, so the scroll position goes with it.
//ReaderGroups: Groups whose members may read crawl state, as DOMAIN\Group or a bare
group name. Empty or absent means any authenticated user, which is what
this site did before the setting existed. Membership is read from the
Windows token, so a user added to a group must sign in again. Either form
works under IIS - live test L4 confirmed BUILTIN\Users resolves - but a SID
such as S-1-5-32-545 needs no resolution and survives a group rename.
